en.label: Trauma & PTSD
en.seoTitle: Trauma & PTSD Therapy in New York City
en.description: EMDR & IFS-informed trauma therapy in NYC with Sharon Miao, LCSW. In-person in New York City or online across NY, NJ & CA. Book a free 15-minute consultation.
en.h1: Trauma & PTSD Therapy in New York City
intro: You may know that an experience is over and still find yourself bracing for what comes next. Feeling disconnected, constantly on alert, or pulled back into painful memories can make everyday life exhausting. If you are looking for a trauma therapist in NYC, you do not need to arrive with a clear diagnosis or a complete account of what happened.

I’m Xiuyun (Sharon) Miao, LCSW. I offer trauma-informed psychotherapy for adults, in person in New York City and through telehealth across New York, New Jersey, and California. As an English- and Mandarin-speaking therapist in NYC, I make room for the cultural and family contexts that shape your experience. We can begin with what feels most important now, choosing an approach and a pace together.
en.signsHeading: Signs trauma may still be affecting you
signs: Unwanted memories or nightmares that interrupt your day or sleep.
Feeling on guard, easily startled, or unable to settle.
Avoiding reminders, places, or conversations connected to what happened.
Feeling numb, disconnected, or distant from people you care about.
Guilt, shame, or difficulty trusting yourself or others.
en.signsNote: These experiences can have different causes. We can explore them together rather than assuming they mean you have PTSD.
en.approachesHeading: Working with a trauma therapist in NYC

approaches.title: EMDR
approaches.body: I am trained in Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR). If we consider this approach, we first discuss your history, current supports, and readiness. Preparation and your ability to stay grounded matter; you can ask questions, pause, or choose another approach.

approaches.title: Internal Family Systems (IFS)
approaches.body: IFS offers a way to explore parts of you that may feel frightened, protective, critical, or overwhelmed. I use this framework to help us understand what these responses are trying to do for you, without treating them as personal failures.

approaches.title: Attachment-based therapy
approaches.body: We can explore how earlier relationships affect closeness, boundaries, and trust today. Our work makes room for both your wish for connection and the ways you have learned to protect yourself. We move at a pace that feels safe enough to stay engaged.

en.formatIntro: We can discuss whether in-person or online sessions best support your needs, privacy, and sense of safety.

faqs.question: Is EMDR right for me?
faqs.answer: EMDR may be one option, but it is not the starting point for everyone. We will consider your concerns, preferences, current stability, and supports before deciding whether to use it. Preparation is part of the work, and you do not have to commit to a particular method before we meet.

faqs.question: I’ve never done therapy before — what happens in the first session?
faqs.answer: We begin by getting to know each other and discussing what brings you to therapy, how things are affecting your life, and what you hope will change. You do not need to describe traumatic experiences in detail. We also review confidentiality, safety, and practical questions about working together.

faqs.question: Do you offer sessions in Mandarin?
faqs.answer: Yes. I offer therapy in English and Mandarin, in person in New York City and online for adults located in New York, New Jersey, or California. You can share your language preference during the free consultation.

faqs.question: How long does trauma therapy usually take?
faqs.answer: There is no single timeline. The concerns you bring, your goals, available supports, and response to treatment all matter. We will review progress together and adjust our pace and approach rather than promise a fixed number of sessions.

en.blogIntro: Trauma and loss can overlap. This reflection considers how connection can continue after someone important is gone.

zh.label: 创伤与 PTSD
zh.seoTitle: 纽约市创伤与 PTSD 心理治疗｜中英双语咨询
zh.description: 苗秀云 Sharon Miao，LCSW 提供纽约市面对面及纽约州、新泽西州、加州线上创伤心理治疗，结合 EMDR、IFS 与依恋取向，支持英语和普通话。预约免费15分钟咨询。
zh.h1: 纽约市创伤与 PTSD 心理治疗
intro: 也许您知道事情已经过去，身体和情绪却仍在为下一次危险做准备。难以放松、与他人疏离，或反复被痛苦记忆拉回过去，都可能让日常生活变得疲惫。如果您正在寻找纽约市的创伤心理治疗师，您不必先有明确诊断，也无需准备好完整讲述自己的经历。
我是苗秀云 Xiuyun (Sharon) Miao，LCSW，为成年人提供纽约市面对面咨询，以及面向纽约州、新泽西州和加州的线上咨询。我提供英语和普通话心理治疗，关注文化、家庭期待与人际关系如何影响您的体验。我们可以从当下最需要支持的部分开始，一起选择适合您的方式与节奏。
zh.signsHeading: 创伤可能仍在影响您的表现
signs: 不由自主出现的回忆或噩梦，影响日常生活与睡眠。
时常警觉、容易受惊，或难以放松。
回避与过去经历有关的地点、话题或其他提醒。
感到麻木、与自己脱节，或与在意的人变得疏远。
内疚、羞耻，或难以信任自己与他人。
zh.signsNote: 这些体验可能有不同原因，并不自动意味着 PTSD。我们会一起了解它们的背景与影响。
zh.approachesHeading: 与纽约市创伤心理治疗师一起工作

approaches.title: EMDR
approaches.body: 我接受过眼动脱敏与再加工疗法（EMDR）培训。如果考虑使用这一方法，我们会先讨论您的经历、当前支持与准备程度。准备工作和保持稳定同样重要；您可以提问、暂停，或选择其他方式。

approaches.title: 内在家庭系统（IFS）
approaches.body: IFS 帮助我们理解内心可能感到害怕、想要保护您、严厉批评自己，或不堪重负的不同部分。我们会探索这些反应的意义，而不是把它们视为您的失败。

approaches.title: 依恋取向治疗
approaches.body: 我们可以了解早期关系如何影响当下的亲密、界限与信任，同时为您渴望联结的一面和保护自己的一面留出空间。治疗会以您能够承受和参与的节奏进行。

zh.formatIntro: 我们会共同讨论，面对面还是线上咨询更适合您的需要、隐私条件与安全感。

faqs.question: EMDR 适合我吗？
faqs.answer: EMDR 是可考虑的方法之一，但并非每个人都需要从它开始。我们会根据您的困扰、偏好、当前状态与支持资源来决定。准备工作也是治疗的一部分，您无需在见面前就选定某种方法。

faqs.question: 我从未做过心理咨询，第一次会发生什么？
faqs.answer: 我们会先彼此了解，讨论您为何来咨询、目前生活受到的影响，以及您希望发生的改变。您不需要详细讲述创伤经历。我们也会讨论保密、安全和咨询安排等问题。

faqs.question: 可以用普通话咨询吗？
faqs.answer: 可以。我提供英语和普通话咨询，可在纽约市面对面进行，也可为位于纽约州、新泽西州或加州的成年人提供线上咨询。免费咨询时可以告诉我您的语言偏好。

faqs.question: 创伤心理治疗通常需要多久？
faqs.answer: 没有适用于所有人的时间表。治疗时长与您的困扰、目标、支持资源及治疗体验有关。我们会定期讨论进展并调整方式，不预先承诺固定次数或结果。

zh.blogIntro: 创伤与失落有时会交织在一起。这篇读后感探讨了失去之后，爱与联结如何继续存在。

en.label: Anxiety & Depression
en.description: Anxiety & depression therapy in NYC with Sharon Miao, LCSW. CBT, IFS & mindfulness-based care, in-person or online across NY, NJ & CA. Free consult.
en.h1: Anxiety & Depression Therapy in New York City
intro: Worry can follow you into quiet moments, while low mood can make ordinary tasks feel unusually heavy. You may keep up with work and responsibilities while privately struggling with self-doubt, exhaustion, or disconnection. If you are searching for an anxiety therapist in NYC, there is room to talk before things reach a breaking point.

I’m Xiuyun (Sharon) Miao, LCSW, an English- and Mandarin-speaking therapist in NYC. I support adults navigating anxiety and depression through in-person sessions in New York City and telehealth across New York, New Jersey, and California. Together, we can explore the patterns affecting your energy, confidence, and relationships, with attention to culture and family expectations. Our work combines reflection with practical tools that fit your life and priorities.
en.signsHeading: Signs it might be more than “just stress”
signs: Worry that is difficult to set aside, even when you want to rest.
Low mood, irritability, or a sense of emptiness that keeps returning.
Less interest or pleasure in activities and relationships.
Changes in sleep, appetite, energy, or concentration.
Avoiding situations, withdrawing from others, or struggling with daily tasks.
en.signsNote: Symptoms can overlap and may also relate to medical conditions or other stressors. An assessment helps us understand what support may fit.
en.approachesHeading: Working with an anxiety therapist in NYC

approaches.title: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
approaches.body: We can examine how thoughts, emotions, and actions influence one another. Together, we may practice responding differently to self-critical thoughts or taking manageable steps toward activities you have been avoiding.

approaches.title: Internal Family Systems (IFS)
approaches.body: We can get curious about the parts of you that worry, push you to achieve, or withdraw when life feels overwhelming. Understanding these responses can make space for a less punishing relationship with yourself.

approaches.title: Mindfulness-based techniques
approaches.body: We may use brief practices to notice thoughts, emotions, and body sensations with less judgment. We adapt these practices to your comfort and preferences; there is no expectation that you should simply think positively or make difficult feelings disappear.

en.formatIntro: Sessions offer space to understand what is happening and consider practical changes between appointments, without adding another standard you have to meet.

faqs.question: Do I need therapy, or is this something I should handle on my own?
faqs.answer: You do not need to prove that things are bad enough to ask for support. If worry, low mood, or self-criticism is affecting your life, a consultation can help you consider whether therapy fits your needs. Seeking help can coexist with the strengths and coping skills you already have.

faqs.question: What does a typical session look like?
faqs.answer: We usually check in about what has been happening, explore a concern or pattern that matters to you, and consider what you want to take from the conversation. Some sessions focus on reflection; others include a practical skill or a manageable next step.

faqs.question: Do you offer sessions in Mandarin?
faqs.answer: Yes. I offer therapy in English and Mandarin, with attention to cultural identity and family expectations. In-person sessions are available in New York City, with telehealth for adults located in New York, New Jersey, and California.

faqs.question: How do I book the free consultation?
faqs.answer: Use the consultation button below to open my TidyCal calendar and choose an available time. The free 15-minute phone call is a chance to share your concerns, ask questions, and consider whether working together feels right.

en.blogIntro: When anxiety or low mood accompanies a loss, this reflection offers another way to think about remembering and reconnecting.

zh.label: 焦虑与抑郁
zh.seoTitle: 纽约市焦虑与抑郁心理治疗｜中英双语咨询
zh.description: 苗秀云 Sharon Miao，LCSW 提供纽约市焦虑与抑郁心理治疗，结合 CBT、IFS 和正念。提供英语、普通话咨询及纽约州、新泽西州、加州线上服务。预约免费咨询。
zh.h1: 纽约市焦虑与抑郁心理治疗
intro: 担忧可能在安静时仍挥之不去，情绪低落也可能让日常小事变得格外沉重。也许您仍在完成工作、照顾家庭，却独自承受着自我怀疑、疲惫或疏离感。如果您正在寻找纽约市的焦虑心理治疗师，不必等到难以维持生活时，才允许自己寻求支持。
我是苗秀云 Xiuyun (Sharon) Miao，LCSW，提供英语和普通话心理治疗。我在纽约市提供面对面咨询，并为位于纽约州、新泽西州和加州的成年人提供线上咨询。我们会一起了解影响精力、自信与关系的模式，同时关注文化背景和家庭期待。治疗既可以是深入理解自己的空间，也可以帮助您尝试适合实际生活的应对方式。
zh.signsHeading: 哪些表现可能不只是“压力大”
signs: 想休息时仍难以放下担忧。
反复出现的低落、烦躁或空虚感。
对原本在意的活动和关系失去兴趣。
睡眠、食欲、精力或注意力发生变化。
回避情境、减少与他人联系，或难以完成日常事务。
zh.signsNote: 不同症状可能重叠，也可能与身体状况或其他压力有关。评估有助于了解适合您的支持。
zh.approachesHeading: 与纽约市焦虑心理治疗师一起工作

approaches.title: 认知行为疗法（CBT）
approaches.body: 我们会探索想法、情绪与行为之间的联系，尝试以不同方式回应自我批评，或用可承受的小步骤重新接近一直回避的活动。

approaches.title: 内在家庭系统（IFS）
approaches.body: 我们可以带着好奇，了解内心担忧、不断要求自己表现出色，或在疲惫时退缩的不同部分。理解这些反应，能为更温和地对待自己留出空间。

approaches.title: 正念方法
approaches.body: 我们可能使用简短练习，觉察想法、情绪和身体感受，并减少评判。练习会依据您的感受和偏好调整，而不是要求您“想开一点”或消除所有困难情绪。

zh.formatIntro: 咨询既提供理解当下体验的空间，也帮助您考虑两次会谈之间可以尝试的改变，不让治疗成为另一项必须达成的标准。

faqs.question: 我需要咨询吗，还是应该自己解决？
faqs.answer: 您不必证明自己已经足够痛苦，才可以寻求支持。如果担忧、低落或自我批评正在影响生活，可以通过初次咨询了解治疗是否适合您。寻求帮助与您已有的能力并不冲突。

faqs.question: 一次咨询通常是什么样的？
faqs.answer: 我们通常会先了解近况，围绕您在意的困扰或反复出现的模式展开讨论，再考虑这次对话对您有什么意义。有些会谈侧重理解，有些会加入实际练习或可尝试的小步骤。

faqs.question: 可以用普通话咨询吗？
faqs.answer: 可以。我提供英语和普通话咨询，并关注文化认同和家庭期待。您可以选择纽约市面对面咨询；线上咨询适用于位于纽约州、新泽西州或加州的成年人。

faqs.question: 如何预约免费咨询？
faqs.answer: 点击下方预约按钮，打开 TidyCal 日历并选择可用时间。免费的15分钟电话交流可以用来简单介绍您的困扰、提出问题，并感受我们是否适合一起工作。

zh.blogIntro: 如果焦虑或低落与失落有关，这篇读后感提供了理解记忆、爱与联结的另一种视角。

en.label: Grief & Loss
en.seoTitle: Grief Counseling in New York City
en.description: Grief counseling in New York City with Sharon Miao, LCSW — a space to mourn without being rushed. In-person in NYC or online across NY, NJ & CA. Free consult.
en.h1: Grief & Loss Therapy in New York City
intro: Grief does not follow a timeline, and it does not only come from death. You may be mourning a person, a relationship, a version of yourself, or a future you expected to have. If you are looking for a grief counselor in NYC, you can bring the parts of your experience that feel difficult to explain or share with others.

I’m Xiuyun (Sharon) Miao, LCSW. I offer a space where loss can be witnessed without pressure to move on. As an English- and Mandarin-speaking therapist in NYC, I attend to the family and cultural meanings of grief. We can meet in person in New York City or through telehealth across New York, New Jersey, and California, making room for remembrance, uncertainty, and the life you are continuing to live.
signs: Longing, sadness, numbness, or feeling disconnected.
Guilt, anger, or questions that do not have a clear answer.
Changes in sleep, appetite, energy, or concentration.
Feeling out of step with people who expect you to be “better.”
Difficulty imagining the future or finding a place for changed relationships.
en.signsNote: Grief is not automatically a disorder. If distress is persistent or daily life feels difficult to manage, we can assess what additional support may help.
en.approachesHeading: Working with a grief counselor in NYC

approaches.title: Attachment-based therapy
approaches.body: We can explore what a relationship meant to you and how its absence is felt now. There is room for affection, anger, unfinished conversations, and mixed feelings. Our work does not require you to erase the bond in order to keep living.

approaches.title: Culturally sensitive therapy
approaches.body: Family expectations, spiritual beliefs, rituals, and language can shape how grief is expressed. I will ask what matters to you rather than assume there is one right way to mourn, remember, or seek support.

approaches.title: Strength-based therapy
approaches.body: Together, we can notice the people, practices, and values that help you through difficult days. Grief can be held without being rushed or fixed, while we also attend to sleep, daily responsibilities, and support that feels manageable.

en.formatIntro: You can use sessions to speak about your loss, sit with what is difficult to name, or consider how to navigate everyday life alongside grief.

faqs.question: It’s been months or years — is it too late for grief counseling?
faqs.answer: It is not too late to seek support. You may want space for a loss that has never felt fully acknowledged, or an anniversary or life change may bring it closer again. We can start with how the loss is affecting you now.

faqs.question: What’s the difference between grief and depression?
faqs.answer: Grief often centers on a loss, while depression may involve more widespread low mood or loss of interest. They can overlap, and neither can be determined from one feeling or a checklist alone. We can explore the pattern, duration, and impact of your experience to guide care.

faqs.question: Do you offer sessions in Mandarin?
faqs.answer: Yes. Sessions are available in English and Mandarin. We can explore how language, culture, and family traditions shape your experience of loss, whether we meet in New York City or online while you are in New York, New Jersey, or California.

faqs.question: What happens in the free consultation?
faqs.answer: The consultation is a free 15-minute phone call. You can share as much or as little as feels useful, ask about my approach, and discuss scheduling. There is no pressure to tell your full story or commit to therapy.

en.blogIntro: For a reflection on continuing bonds after loss, read about the ways love and memory can remain part of life.

source.label: American Psychiatric Association: Prolonged Grief Disorder

zh.label: 哀伤与失落
zh.seoTitle: 纽约市哀伤与失落心理咨询｜中英双语支持
zh.description: 苗秀云 Sharon Miao，LCSW 提供纽约市哀伤心理咨询，以英语和普通话陪伴丧亲及其他失落。可面对面或于纽约州、新泽西州、加州线上咨询。预约免费15分钟交流。
zh.h1: 纽约市哀伤与失落心理咨询
intro: 哀伤没有统一的时间表，也不只来自死亡。您可能正在哀悼一个人、一段关系、某个版本的自己，或一个曾经期待的未来。如果您正在寻找纽约市的哀伤心理咨询师，那些难以解释、也不容易与他人分享的体验，都可以带进我们的对话。
我是苗秀云 Xiuyun (Sharon) Miao，LCSW。我希望提供一个让失落被看见、而不被催促“走出来”的空间。我以英语和普通话开展咨询，关注家庭和文化赋予哀伤的不同意义。我们可以在纽约市面对面见面，也可以在您位于纽约州、新泽西州或加州时线上交流，为记忆、不确定，以及仍在继续的生活留出空间。
signs: 思念、悲伤、麻木，或与周围人事疏离。
内疚、愤怒，或反复思考没有答案的问题。
睡眠、食欲、精力或注意力发生变化。
与期待您“已经好起来”的人难以同步。
难以想象未来，或适应已经改变的关系。
zh.signsNote: 哀伤本身并不自动意味着心理障碍。如果痛苦持续影响日常生活，我们可以一起评估您需要的支持。
zh.approachesHeading: 与纽约市哀伤心理咨询师一起工作

approaches.title: 依恋取向治疗
approaches.body: 我们可以探索这段关系对您的意义，以及它的缺席如何影响当下。爱、愤怒、未完成的对话和复杂感受，都可以被容纳。继续生活不必以抹去联结为前提。

approaches.title: 文化敏感性治疗
approaches.body: 家庭期待、信仰、仪式与语言，都可能影响哀伤的表达。我会了解对您重要的事，而不预设某一种哀悼、纪念或求助方式才是正确的。

approaches.title: 优势取向治疗
approaches.body: 我们可以一起发现，哪些人、习惯与价值观帮助您度过困难的日子。哀伤可以被承载，而不被催促或修复；同时，我们也会照顾睡眠、日常责任和可承受的支持安排。

zh.formatIntro: 您可以在咨询中谈论失去的人或事，停留在难以命名的感受里，也可以讨论如何带着哀伤继续面对日常生活。

faqs.question: 已经过去几个月甚至几年了，现在咨询还来得及吗？
faqs.answer: 寻求支持并不晚。也许您希望一段未被充分看见的失落得到回应，也许纪念日或生活变化让哀伤再次靠近。我们可以从它现在对您的影响开始。

faqs.question: 哀伤与抑郁有什么区别？
faqs.answer: 哀伤通常围绕失落展开；抑郁可能伴随更广泛的情绪低落或兴趣减退。两者也可能同时存在，不能仅凭一种感受或清单判断。我们会了解体验的模式、持续时间与生活影响，再讨论适合的支持。

faqs.question: 可以用普通话咨询吗？
faqs.answer: 可以。咨询可使用英语或普通话。我们可以了解语言、文化和家庭传统如何影响您的失落体验。您可选择纽约市面对面咨询，或在纽约州、新泽西州、加州进行线上咨询。

faqs.question: 免费咨询会谈些什么？
faqs.answer: 这是一次免费的15分钟电话交流。您可以按自己的意愿简单分享、了解我的工作方式，并讨论预约安排。无需完整讲述自己的故事，也不必立即决定是否开始治疗。

zh.blogIntro: 这篇读后感讨论了持续的联结：失去之后，爱、记忆和影响如何仍在我们的生活中。

en.label: Life Transitions
en.description: Therapy for life transitions in NYC with Sharon Miao, LCSW. In-person in New York City or online across NY, NJ & CA. Book a free 15-minute consultation.
en.h1: Therapy for Life Transitions in New York City
intro: A move, a career shift, a relationship ending, or becoming a parent can change more than your routine. You may find yourself questioning where you belong, what you want, or which expectations are truly yours. Looking for a life transition therapist in NYC can be a way to make room for these questions, even when a change was something you chose.

I’m Xiuyun (Sharon) Miao, LCSW, an English- and Mandarin-speaking therapist in NYC. I work with adults navigating change, including relocation, immigration, and the demands of living between cultures. I offer in-person sessions in New York City and telehealth across New York, New Jersey, and California. Together, we can explore what you are leaving, what you want to carry forward, and how to build a more authentic way of living.
signs: Relocation, immigration, or adjusting to life in a new country or city.
Career changes, uncertainty about direction, or shifts in work identity.
Relationship endings and changes in family roles.
Becoming a parent or adapting to new caregiving responsibilities.
Changes in identity, belonging, values, or expectations for the future.
en.signsNote: You can feel grateful for a new opportunity and still grieve what has changed. Mixed feelings are welcome here.
en.approachesHeading: Working with a life transition therapist in NYC

approaches.title: Psychodynamic therapy
approaches.body: We can explore how earlier experiences and recurring patterns shape the choices you face now. Understanding why certain changes feel especially difficult can help you consider your needs with more clarity.

approaches.title: Culturally sensitive therapy
approaches.body: Immigration and cross-cultural life may involve language, belonging, family responsibilities, and conflicting expectations. I will make room for these realities without assuming that your experience matches anyone else’s story.

approaches.title: Attachment-based therapy
approaches.body: Changes often affect the relationships that help us feel secure. We can explore connection, boundaries, and support as roles shift, while considering how to make room for your own preferences and an authentic way of living.

en.formatIntro: Sessions can offer a steady place to reflect as circumstances change, whether you are settling into New York City or adjusting to a new chapter elsewhere in the states I serve.

faqs.question: I’m functioning fine — is therapy still useful during a transition?
faqs.answer: You do not need to be unable to function to use therapy. You may want a space to understand mixed feelings, clarify your priorities, or think through a change without having to meet other people’s expectations. We can discuss what would make the work useful to you.

faqs.question: I just moved to a new country or city. Can you help with that?
faqs.answer: We can explore the emotional and relational side of relocation, including loneliness, belonging, identity, and family expectations. I offer culturally sensitive support in English and Mandarin. Telehealth is available when you are located in New York, New Jersey, or California; in-person sessions are in New York City.

faqs.question: Do you offer sessions in Mandarin?
faqs.answer: Yes. I offer sessions in English and Mandarin. You can discuss which language feels most comfortable for the experiences you want to explore, including how culture and family shape your choices.

faqs.question: How do I book the free consultation?
faqs.answer: Select the free consultation button below and choose an available time in the TidyCal calendar. During the 15-minute phone call, we can discuss what is changing in your life, your questions, and whether working together feels like a good fit.

en.blogIntro: Transitions can include letting go of a relationship, an expected future, or a familiar identity. This reflection explores how loss and ongoing connection can coexist.

zh.label: 人生转变
zh.seoTitle: 纽约市人生转变心理咨询｜移居与跨文化支持
zh.description: 苗秀云 Sharon Miao，LCSW 提供纽约市人生转变心理咨询，关注移居、职业、关系与身份变化。英语及普通话服务，纽约州、新泽西州、加州可线上咨询。预约免费15分钟交流。
zh.h1: 纽约市人生转变心理咨询
intro: 搬家、转行、结束一段关系，或成为父母，改变的可能不只是生活安排。您也许开始重新思考：我属于哪里？我真正想要什么？哪些期待是自己的，哪些来自他人？寻找纽约市的人生转变心理治疗师，可以为这些问题留出空间，即使改变本身是您主动选择的。
我是苗秀云 Xiuyun (Sharon) Miao，LCSW，以英语和普通话为成年人提供心理治疗。我关注移居、移民以及跨文化生活中的情绪和关系体验，在纽约市提供面对面咨询，并为位于纽约州、新泽西州和加州的人士提供线上咨询。我们可以一起了解正在告别的事物、希望带入未来的价值，以及更贴近真实自我的生活方式。
zh.signsHeading: 我们可以共同探索的转变
signs: 搬迁、移民，或适应新的国家与城市。
职业变化、方向不确定，或工作身份的改变。
关系结束，以及家庭角色的变化。
成为父母，或承担新的照顾责任。
身份认同、归属感、价值观与未来期待的变化。
zh.signsNote: 您可以珍惜新的机会，同时为已经改变的事物感到失落。复杂、矛盾的感受都可以带进咨询。
zh.approachesHeading: 与纽约市人生转变心理治疗师一起工作

approaches.title: 心理动力学治疗
approaches.body: 我们可以探索早期经历和反复出现的模式，如何影响当下面临的选择。理解某些变化为何格外困难，有助于更清楚地看见自己的需要。

approaches.title: 文化敏感性治疗
approaches.body: 移民与跨文化生活可能涉及语言、归属感、家庭责任和相互冲突的期待。我会为这些现实留出空间，而不假设您的故事与任何其他人相同。

approaches.title: 依恋取向治疗
approaches.body: 变化常常影响那些让我们感到安全的关系。随着角色改变，我们可以探索联结、界限与支持，也为您自己的偏好和更真实的生活方式留出空间。

zh.formatIntro: 无论您正在适应纽约市的生活，还是在我服务的其他州开启新阶段，咨询都可以成为一个相对稳定、持续思考的空间。

faqs.question: 我的生活还能正常运转，转变期间咨询有必要吗？
faqs.answer: 您不需要等到无法维持生活才寻求咨询。您可能想理解复杂感受、梳理优先事项，或暂时放下他人的期待，认真思考改变。我们可以共同讨论，什么会让咨询对您有意义。

faqs.question: 我刚搬到新的国家或城市，可以谈这些吗？
faqs.answer: 可以。我们可以探索搬迁带来的情绪与关系体验，包括孤独、归属、身份和家庭期待。我提供英语与普通话的文化敏感性支持。面对面咨询在纽约市进行，线上咨询适用于位于纽约州、新泽西州或加州的人士。

faqs.question: 可以用普通话咨询吗？
faqs.answer: 可以。我提供英语和普通话咨询。您可以选择更容易表达相关经历的语言，也可以讨论文化与家庭如何影响您的选择。

faqs.question: 如何预约免费咨询？
faqs.answer: 点击下方免费咨询按钮，在 TidyCal 日历中选择可用时间。在15分钟电话交流中，我们可以简单讨论您正经历的变化、您的问题，以及我们是否适合一起工作。

zh.blogIntro: 人生转变也可能意味着告别一段关系、一个期待中的未来，或熟悉的身份。这篇文章探讨失落与持续联结如何并存。
